SamenvattingLooking for a dynamic role in logistics with a well-known supermarket in Almere? As an Orderpicker, you’ll work in a fast-paced environment, enjoy great benefits, and have opportunities to grow. Start your logistics career in Almere today. Good work!Over de functieYou will play a key role in making sure supermarket products reach customers on time. Your daily work as an Orderpicker involves collecting supermarket items from the warehouse shelves and preparing orders for delivery. You’ll use hand scanners and work both in cold and warm areas, so you need to be ready for different environments. Each shift is active and can include a lot of walking.
- Pick and scan supermarket products for customer orders
- Work in both warm and cold areas of the warehouse
- Meet weekly picking targets and quality standards
- Keep your workspace organized and clean
- Switch between departments when needed

You’ll work day shifts (6:00-14:30), evening shifts (14:30-23:00), and after training, potentially night shifts (23:00-6:00) from Monday till Saturday.
Over het bedrijfAt this leading logistics company, you’ll become part of the team that keeps supermarket shelves stocked and customer orders moving. The workplace in Almere is a modern warehouse where efficiency and teamwork are highly valued. You can expect a friendly vibe, with team members supporting each other and a buddy system in place to help new colleagues get started. In the canteen, you’ll find free fruit and a warm meal during afternoon shifts, plus a coffee and tea station to keep you energized. If you enjoy an active job and being part of a supportive team, this is the place for you.
 Wat wij vragen- Private accommodation 
- Able to speak and understand English
- Available for at least 32 hours per week, including Saturdays
- Willing to work in both cold and warm areas and switch departments as needed
- Punctual, reliable, and a good team player
- No previous experience needed, but similar roles like ware

Do you want to use and further develop your technical skills? As a cnc operator, you get the chance to work with the most modern machines in the production of high-tech parts. You work full-time, during the day, in an innovative environment where your development is key. You’ll have plenty of opportunities for training and to grow within the company. Let that bank account fill up! As a logistics employee nightshifts at PostNL in Tiel, you earn extra money thanks to the bonuses. At night, your hourly wage can go up to € 17,78! Plus, you stay physically active during work. So you can easily cancel that gym subscription when you take this job. Curious about the tasks? Read on!

What we offer
- Salary: € 14,40 per hour
- Travel allowance
- Bonuses: 20% and 30% after 10:00 PM
- Growth opportunities
- Weekly payments and pension scheme
- 8+ satisfaction score for work enjoyment!

Who you are
As a logistics employee nightshifts, you help with loading and unloading trucks. This means moving roll containers that can weigh up to 150 kilos. No problem for you! Additionally, you are available for at least three evenings/nights and:

- You can request a VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct);
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to work.

What will you do
PostNL Tiel is one of PostNL's crossdock locations. Here, roll containers full of packages are transferred to be sent to the correct destination with a different driver. How does this work? Trucks arrive with, for example, three roll containers for the Tilburg region and three for the Breda region. Each region is collected separately so that a full truck can drive to Tilburg and another to Breda. This saves unnecessary trips across the country for just a few roll containers. As a logistics employee nightshifts, you unload the trucks and place the roll containers in the right sections. Is there an empty truck that needs to be filled? You make sure the correct roll containers are loaded. Then you neatly put the roll containers back into the truck.

- Flexible working hours in rotation from 09:00 PM to 05:30 AM, 10:00 PM to 06:00 AM, 00:30 AM to 09:00 AM and 01:30 AM to 10:00 AM.
- Working days Monday through Friday and Sunday in rotation.

Where will you work
The PostNL Tiel warehouse is located at Hoekwei 6 in Tiel. You can easily reach it by car,
